chunks: God has made a promise of forgiveness and the highest reward to those who believe and perform good deeds.
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for receiving God's promise of forgiveness and great reward?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to affirm the inseparable link between faith and action, countering sects that prioritize one over the other. It underscores the concept of 'Ajl al-Kabir' (Great Reward) as a distinct divine gift for those who maintain consistency in their deeds, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the integration of belief (Iman) and practice (Amal).
